title: Finally made a purchase in Mall World, but.....
content: So usually in my dreams I wait in line to buy stuff, or if it's food I just eat it intending to pay when I get to the checkout areas (I would never do that IRL). Last night I was in a part of the mall with a clothing store that had a beautiful outfit on a mannequin. It was also very much discounted, so I asked to see it and I just said I'd take it instead of trying it on. Most dreams, if I make it to the try on rooms, the dream flips and I am in the bathroom maze or outside the mall altogether instantly. So the clerk put it into a cute little paper shopping bag. Then I made the mistake of continuing to shop, and got distracted by the candy/junk food store. I knelt down to grab some candy, and I paid for that too and left the store. Suddenly, my phone rang (usually my phone is not functioning in dreams) and it was my spouse asking what I just bought on the debit card because it was showing something weird, and I said an outfit and candy. But as I said it, I realized I did not have the bag with the clothes. And I was arriving home. And my spouse said you should call the mall and find out if anyone found your bag, and I said I'd call the candy place because maybe I left it there. Apparently, the outfit was on sale, but was still like, many thousands of dollars or something ridiculous. Anyway, I called and the manager said yes she had it behind the counter. I went and picked it up and she said I was lucky she found it because someone else probably would have stole it. Just to be safe, I went and put on the outfit, which was very amazing and fit me like it was made for me. Which also never happens IRL.
